Gatekeeper Protocol, implemented in Sage (open-source agent, github.com/Fikresilase/sage); version Not stated. Baselines: Full Codebase, Recent Files, RAG (ChromaDB, 512-token chunks, cosine similarity), ReAct agent

A single JSON object, the System State-Context Representation (SCR): a low-fidelity latent context map of the system (components may be 'unsummarized'), the authoritative state record, and the action interface (agent writes declarative intents such as provide/edit/write/delete into 'request' fields). No requirements or specification document

Time-stepped cycle: agent receives SCR L_t + task T -> proposes modified SCR L'_t with a declarative action (e.g. provide to request high-fidelity content) -> system validates (IsValid) and executes (Phi) -> new ground-truth SCR L_t+1. Inference-first: reason on latent map before requesting content

Not stated how sub-task completion and grounding errors were judged (automatic or manual); tokens presumably logged. Averaged over 7 model runs per task, then over 3 tasks

Criterion: sub-task completion. Values averaged across 3 tasks and 7 LLMs (Gemini 2.0 Flash Exp, Qwen3 Coder 480B A35B, DeepSeek R1, MAI DS R1, gpt-oss-20b, Mistral Small 3.2 24B, Nemotron Nano 9B V2); per-model values not reported, so one entry per strategy. (a) Sage (Gatekeeper) + Sage + 7 models (avg): completion 73% +/- 8; grounding errors 0.8 +/- 0.4; tokens 6,200 +/- 1,200. Quality partly works; cost works. (b) Full Codebase + harness n.s. + 7 models: 48% +/- 18; 4.3 +/- 2.1; 19,100 +/- 3,500. Quality does not work; cost does not work. (c) Recent Files + n.s. + 7 models: 31% +/- 22; 5.8 +/- 2.5; 9,800 +/- 4,100. Quality does not work; cost partly. (d) RAG + n.s. + 7 models: 58% +/- 15; 3.1 +/- 1.5; 14,300 +/- 2,800. Quality partly; cost partly. (e) ReAct Agent + n.s. + 7 models: 55% +/- 17; 3.4 +/- 1.8; 15,200 +/- 3,100. Quality partly; cost partly

Tasks: 3 (Python refactoring, React component, Python web scraping); not released. Configurations: 5 strategies x 7 LLMs. Baselines: Full Codebase, Recent Files, RAG, ReAct agent. Held constant: standardized prompts; ReAct given identical imperative toolset to Sage; model across strategies. Acceptance tests: Not stated (sub-task completion). Repetitions: Not stated (R = 7 refers to the 7 model runs, apparently one run per model per task). Human intervention: Not stated

Sage best on all three metrics: completion 73% vs RAG 58% (next best), ReAct 55%, Full 48%, Recent 31%; grounding errors 0.8 vs 3.1-5.8 ('an order of magnitude fewer'); tokens 6,200 vs 9,800-19,100 ('over twice as token-efficient'). No significance tests

Distinguished strategies on means (no statistical test). Repeatability not addressed (no repetitions, no task release). Limitations stated: only three tasks; RAG sensitive to chunking/embedding configuration

Protocol limits: needs structured knowledge; adds latency (multi-turn); bounded by LLM reasoning; initial latent-map generation can be costly for very large systems. Evaluation: only three tasks, larger benchmark needed; RAG configuration sensitivity. Future: hierarchical 'latent map tree', model chaining/query transformation, universal Gatekeeper specification
